## X360 Manager v1.6.1

### Highlights
- **Custom app icon** - fixed installer / Start Menu / taskbar (no more default Electron icon)
- **Smoother library** - debounced saves, fixed cover-sync loop, faster cover loading
- **Fullscreen fixed** - no longer stuck after game options; Esc / F11 / Windowed to exit

### Download
Install **X360-Manager-Setup-1.6.1.exe** (Windows 10/11, 64-bit). Optional: **X360-Manager-Portable-1.6.1.zip**.

### Setup
1. Run the installer (or unzip portable).
2. Unpin old shortcuts and pin again if the icon looks cached.
3. Data folder: `%APPDATA%\x360-manager\` (settings, library, covers).
